mapper.sql: SELECT template.id AS template_id, template.template_key, template.status AS template_status, template.version AS template_version, version.id AS version_id, version.version_number, version.status AS version_status, version.name_zh, version.name_en, version.description, version.risk_level, version.payload_format, version.parameter_schema::TEXT AS parameter_schema_json, version.raw_payload, version.raw_payload_hex, version.raw_payload_sha256, version.default_ttl_seconds, version.default_timeout_seconds, version.requires_reason, version.reply_expected, version.created_at, version.updated_at, version.published_at, version.version AS lock_version FROM cmd_template template JOIN cmd_template_version version ON version.template_id = template.id
mapper.select: JOIN cmd_template_binding binding ON binding.template_version_id = version.id JOIN dev_device device ON device.product_id = binding.product_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ENABLED' AND template.status = 'ACTIVE' AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version.name_zh, template.template_key

JOIN cmd_template_binding binding ON binding.template_version_id = version.id JOIN dev_device device ON device.product_id = binding.product_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ENABLED' AND template.status = 'ACTIVE' AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND template.template_key = #{templateKey} LIMIT 1
